overview_description.description: Dallal provides services for buying, selling, and renting properties. The platform lists residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural properties, and land. Legal assistance is available for property transactions, including documentation and approvals. Users can list their properties for sale or rent to reach potential buyers or tenants. The company offers consultancy to help clients secure loans for property purchases.
